Subject: PO cadence + invoice triggers for Q3 bookings

Hi Kimberly,

We are finalizing internal schedules for upcoming commitments and want to align on how PO arrival windows map to your invoice triggers so our revenue ops team can correctly recognize bookings. Key constraints on our side:
- Central procurement cutover for new contracts: 2026-08-16 (they batch POs weekly)
- Finance needs an invoice-ready PO before the billing date to recognize the booking in the same month

Can you confirm:
1) The latest PO receipt date that still lets Redwood issue an invoice dated 8/31 and have the booking recognized in August?
2) If a PO arrives after that cutoff, what is the expected invoice date and recognition month?
3) Any documentation or PO template we should use to avoid delays?

I attached the mutual action plan draft and our PO template. Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement
Brightbridge Health

Attachments: Draft_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, PO_Template_Brightbridge.xlsx
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO cadence + invoice triggers for Q3 bookings

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear breakdown. Short answers up front:
1) If we receive a completed PO (signed and with billing address/payment terms) by 2026-08-23 EOD PT, we can target an invoice dated 2026-08-31 and include the booking in August recognition.
2) POs received after 2026-08-23 will roll to the next invoicing run (we typically invoice on the last business day of the month), so recognition would fall into September. If your procurement team can mark an earlier effective date on the PO and include the standard T&Cs, we can sometimes accommodate backdating for recognition — but that requires explicit legal/finance signoff and the PO to reference the same contract id.
3) I've attached our PO template and a short checklist (required fields) — this prevents common processing delays (missing billing contact, PO number format, tax/exemption details).

Operational notes for your finance team:
- Must include a purchase order number in the body of the PO PDF (not just in the filename).
- Billing address and remittance email must match the contacts in our system. Deviations trigger a manual validation that adds 3–5 business days.
- For milestone invoicing (e.g., 50/50 or usage-based), list each milestone, the associated amount, and the expected completion date; we will tie the invoice issuance to milestone completion confirmation.

I'll loop in Laura from Revenue Ops for recognition specifics and Vivek from Billing to confirm the exact cutoffs. If your procurement team wants a 20-minute walkthrough of the template, we can set one up tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Samantha — quick fiscal clarification from Revenue Ops:
- The 8/23 receipt cutoff Kimberly mentioned is the operational deadline to route through AR and appear on the 8/31 invoice run. That assumes the PO is fully-complete and references their contract ID RDW-7891.
- If Brightbridge requests recognition for services delivered in August but the PO arrives after 8/23, we can evaluate a one-off recognition if (a) the PO explicitly authorizes retro recognition and (b) there's an email chain from an authorized Brightbridge approver confirming acceptance of August delivery. This is an exception, not standard process, and will require sign-off from our finance controller.

Please include the following on the PO to reduce back-and-forth:
- Exact legal entity name (Brightbridge Health, Inc.)
- Contract ID: RDW-7891
- Billing contact: ops.finance@brightbridgehealth.com
- Invoicing frequency: monthly, invoice on last business day

If you want, Neha from AR can provide a short list of common rejections we see so the PO team can pre-check before submission.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
